variants.title: Compton scattering from a plastic scintillator, gated by coincidence
variants.sample: Plastic scintillator scatterer (polystyrene rod, 3 cm by 5 cm), gated by its own pulse
variants.unknown: the electron rest energy and d sigma / d Omega against angle
variants.note: The scatterer is itself a scintillator: the recoil electron makes a pulse that opens a gate on the MCA, so only photons that really scattered in it are recorded. The gate removes 98 % of the room background; the gate threshold of 30 keV is passed at every angle above 20 degrees. 1.21e25 electrons: polystyrene 1.06 g/cm3, Z/A 0.53768.

source.title: NIST composition table: polystyrene density 1.06 g/cm3, Z/A = 0.53768

variants.aim: Scatter the 662 keV gamma rays of Cs-137 from a plastic scintillator rod whose own pulse gates the NaI(Tl) spectrometer (coincidence), measure the scattered energy at seven angles and find the electron rest energy from E'(theta).
